name: Tick
description: Minecraft's unit of game time: 20 a second.

pages.title: Tick
pages.text:
A **tick** is Minecraft's step of game time: 20 ticks make one second when the game runs at full speed.\
\
Burn times are often in ticks: 24000 ticks is 20 minutes. Chunks that "tick" keep their machines running.
